name: Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling - San Leandro Production Plant, CA

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (37.7129,-122.1609 / 1101 Marina Blvd) landed in a retail district and were wrong. Multiple business directories and a Birdeye 'Reyes Coca-Cola Truck Entrance' listing confirm the facility at 14655 Wicks Blvd, San Leandro 94577, coordinates 37.7003,-122.1658. The plant is the large gray-roofed multi-tenant warehouse centered ~37.6991,-122.1684.
fieldNotes.building: Large industrial warehouse shared by Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling and at least one co-tenant (Accu-Logistics LLC signage visible on the east end). Reyes runs a distribution/production operation in the western/larger portion; red Coca-Cola trailers backed into the south-face docks confirm identity.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Driver reviews explicitly reference a gate ('park on the curb, just inside the gate'). The south dock yard is enclosed by chain-link fencing with green privacy slats. Truck entrance is on the SE/E side off Griffith St. No barrier arm clearly resolved in imagery but yard is fenced and controlled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the truck entrance in any Street View or satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Driver reviews describe a remote/appointment check-in ('no check-in until 30 minutes before appointment', 'no restroom') consistent with a kiosk/call-box rather than a staffed booth.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Drivers are directed to park on Griffith St (public curb) when arriving early - functions as informal pre-gate staging on the street.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Truck queue spills onto the public industrial street (Griffith St); driver reviews complain of no parking before appointment.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~25-30 dock doors counted along the building south face from z19/z20 imagery, with ~22 trailers backed in (red Coca-Cola, white, blue). Count is an estimate - banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Fenced paved dock yard south of the building holds parked trailers separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~330m N-S x ~110m E-W building+yard parcel) ~ 9 acres - approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock bank along the south face; no separate ship/receive clusters identified.

citations.claim: San Leandro named as one of three current CA locations where Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling manufactures

verification.rationale: Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling-operated NorCal production plant (San Leandro); named as a current CA manufacturing site in 2023.
